prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1233; do not mention it.)
text:
Please be advised that this firm represents the above-referenced individual in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end motor vehicle collision. Our client was struck from behind while stopped in traffic, and has since required medical treatment for injuries that continue to affect daily life and ability to work.

Effective immediately, all communication regarding this claim must be directed to our office. Please do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Any inquiries from your adjusters or representatives should be routed to this firm.

We request that you provide the policy limits of liability coverage applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page, within thirty days of receipt of this letter.

Finally, we demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data, claim file materials, recorded statements, telematics information, and any other documentation in your possession, custody, or control. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions.
